failure_patterns.pattern: pending_input_misresolution: Users supplied dates for pending flight and hotel requests, but the agent asked for information again instead of executing the now-complete requests.

rejected_edits.content: - On each turn, use the full conversation and compatible cached results, but act only on domains, itinerary legs, and criteria requested now or supplied this turn for a pending request. Do not retrieve or filter unrelated results. For a follow-up criterion, retrieve the latest compatible result for that domain and subject, including the latest filtered result, and pass its full result—not a summary or stale variable—to the appropriate filter. Apply only the newly stated criterion, preserving constraints already applied, and save the updated result under a unique cache key. Search only when a requested entity or category is not covered by a compatible cached result. Save each newly generated search or transformation result under a unique cache key. Use “No planning needed” only when no current or pending request requires action.
rejected_edits.target: - On each turn, consider the full conversation and cached result summaries. Reuse cached results only when their domain and subject match the request. If the user adds criteria, retrieve the closest compatible result, apply the matching filter, and save the updated result. Do not filter unrelated results; search for a requested entity or category that the cached results do not cover. Avoid retrieving unrelated results or repeating constraints in filters that were already applied. Save each newly generated search or transformation result under a unique cache key. Use “No planning needed” only when cached results already satisfy every current request.

rejected_edits.content: - For a recommendation near another result type, ensure compatible results are available for exactly the two domains in the current request. Reuse matching cached results; search for a missing requested result set, or apply the stated criteria to its compatible cached base. Then call `search_nearest` with both full result objects, including any requested filters, and save its result. Do not pass an absent or placeholder result set. Set `groupBy` to the organizing domain; when lodging is the planned base, use `hotel`.
rejected_edits.target: - For recommendations near another result type, ensure compatible results for both types are available, then call `search_nearest` and save its result. Set `groupBy` to the domain the user wants as the organizing base; when lodging is the planned base, group by hotel.
